name: AnimateCSS Block
description: assigns Animate.css entrance/attention animations to Drupal blocks via the AnimateCSS module.
project_description:
This module enables easy integration of Animate CSS for blocks, allowing for streamlined animation configuration and customization.

 Features 
 
 Effortless Block Animation: Enable animations for any block with easy configuration from block settings. 
 Wide Range of Animations: Choose from a variety of animations to enhance your site’s user experience. 
 Customizable Delays & Speeds: Set custom delays and adjust animation speeds to fit your needs. 
 Animation Repetition: Control how many times animations repeat for dynamic effects. 
 Clean Previous Classes: Remove old Animate.css classes to avoid conflicts with new settings. 
 Display Fixes: Automatically adjust display properties for smooth animations. 
 Event-Based Triggers: Trigger animations on specific events for more control. 
 Live Preview: See your animation settings in real-time before saving. 
 Scroll Reveal Integration: Add scroll-triggered animations with AOS or WOW JS integration. 
 Customizable Form Settings: Personalize the block configuration form with tailored options. 
 User-Friendly Interface: Simple, intuitive interface for configuring animations easily. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Animate CSS (Module) 
integrates the Animate.css library with Drupal which allows you to makes cross-browser animations for use in your web projects. 
 Animate.css (Library) 
is a library of ready-to-use, cross-browser animations for use in your web projects. Great for emphasis, home pages, sliders, and attention-guiding hints. 
 
 Support 
 Please let me know if a new feature is needed or if there are any issues and feedback. You can announce it in the AnimateCSS Block Issues section.
